_purpose: Dynamic cost function spec — all inputs are variables, no hardcoded values

total_project_cost.formula: C_labour + C_equipment + C_material + C_overhead + C_penalty + C_social

C_labour.formula: SUM over tasks: workers_required[t] * unit_cost[resource_type[t]] * actual_duration[t] * (1 + overtime_factor[t])

C_equipment.formula: SUM over tasks: SUM over equipment_types: units[t][eq] * equip_day_rate[eq] * actual_duration[t]

C_social.formula: SUM over days×blocks: is_peak[block] * delay_index[day][block] > 0.5 * traffic_disruption_rate * block_duration_hrs
C_social.note: societal cost — not in contractor budget but in system objective

decision_variables_for_optimiser: start_day[t]        — integer, day task t begins
block_assignment[t] — which time block each task runs in each day
workers_assigned[t][d] — integer, workers assigned per task per day
equipment_assigned[t][d][eq] — integer units per task per day
